The biggest market surprise came via Cinos Legacy, who scored at $41 at Newcastle. It was not all plain sailing for the short elects, as Baker Creek NZ ($1.06), Rossini ($1.33), and Ultimate Rocker NZ ($1.50) could not justify short quotes at Wagga; punters missed with Starvin Marvin NZ ($1.30), Mondooley Mach ($1.40), and Our Amazing Grace ($1.60) at Mildura; Okanagan ($1.40) was beaten at Albion Park; Collina Kay Jay ($1.40) could not get the job done at Goulburn; while the short-priced Spotlight ($1.70) came unstuck at Bendigo.
